Madam
I am much obliged for your great kindness in allowing [my mother](/person/1606) and myself the perusal of the enclosed valuable letter. I have been from home for some days, or I would sooner have returned it, and expressed our best thanks for the favour of its perusal
yours much obliged

C M Yonge
